initial.male:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: Questwell Scout starter class garment-only overlay.
Image 1 is the Scout design to rebuild cleanly. Image 2 is the approved Scholar garment, used ONLY as an exact canvas-placement, body-fit and finish guide; do not reproduce navy or purple. Image 3 is the frozen base avatar to fit. Do not render the avatar in the output.
Create a crisp, carefully drawn forest-green and warm-gold Scout longcoat on a fully transparent 3:4 canvas. Preserve Scout's existing identity and distinct shoulder/hem motifs. Opaque smooth forest-green sleeves, dark-green lining, deliberate folds, continuous even-width gold piping, elegant fitted lapels and long split tails. Clean small gold cuff bands follow the actual wrists; eliminate oversized bell cuffs and hollow flared ends. The center opening and space between sleeves/torso must be truly transparent. No person, head, hair, neck, shirt, tie, belt, trousers, hands, boots, mannequin, background, shadow, grid or text. No detached gold fragments, duplicate edges, ragged transparent holes, blurry AI ornament.
Placement must match Image 2: leave the top ~24% and bottom ~8% of the canvas transparent, center around x=50%. Keep the longcoat at the SAME normalized scale and origin as the garment in Image 2. Every feature must fit the corresponding body in Image 3. Output only the single garment. Target canvas 960x1280.
Male fit in normalized 240x320 coordinates: neck at (108,77)/(130,77); shoulders (81,87)/(155,89); shoulder outer tips (70,101)/(165,101); elbows outer (65,136)/(169,136); cuffs run x62..81 and x156..175 ending y174, not below. Waist at y151. Split tails end about (85,290)/(156,290), outer flare x61..177 at y246. Retain the original male Scout four-point gold shoulder motifs and angular diamond hem trim. Keep trim simple and continuous.

finish.male:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this exact transparent Scout longcoat asset to improve its finish. The given image is the edit target, not a loose style reference.
CRITICAL: preserve the 3:4 canvas composition and the coat's current position, width, shoulder locations, wrist locations and hem length. Keep the large transparent head space above y=76/320 and space below y=291/320. Do not zoom, enlarge, center the coat differently, or crop empty space. Output only the same garment at the same normalized position.
This is the male body garment for an already fitted avatar. Keep each cuff at its present position (around y=170/320), compact, solid and clean. Keep the lapel opening transparent and unchanged. Retain the forest green fabric, warm gold trim, distinctive existing shoulder motifs, four-point shoulder and cuff motifs, split long tails and diamond hem motifs.
Clean only the finish: smooth the accidental wavy/kinked gold piping from the waist to the hem into one elegant flowing line on each side. Remove irregular bulges in the coat fronts, squared accidental side protrusions, redundant disconnected tiny lines and speckles. Make all gold piping continuous and even in width, neat hem contours, natural restrained sleeve folds. No garbled gold ornaments. Preserve the tailored silhouette and body-specific sleeve angles. Crisp richly shaded illustrated fantasy game art matching the input finish, not flat vector.
No head, body, hair, face, hands, belt, shirt, tie, trousers or shoes. No background or shadow. Actual transparency everywhere outside the fabric and through the front opening. Do not fill the torso opening.
